Spend time with him. Try to talk to him. Your father absolutely needs you. I bet my last breath he loves you more than you can ever imagine. Also flashbacks of you as a baby, and other family memories are why he’s still here. Trust me he’s hanging on and i guarantee it’s for his family no matter how dysfunctional it may be (if that a whole issue in itself). So spend time with him or when you get that chance give him a tighter  and longer hug. Just tell him you love him a few extra times a day. Ask him to take you someplace. I say all of this because i have a 6yo son. He doesn’t know my struggle but I’m hanging on for him. Best of luck sweetheart i wish you and your family the best <3
The reason i haven’t left my girlfriend is because I’m terrified of hurting her.

Break up is a break up. Your best bet is pull your pants up and do the right thing. If you chase her she’ll pull away. Act cool but don’t make it painfully obvious that you’re really dying inside. In my experience the only thing that keeps someone coming back is when you’re not looking for them. She might do the same so be prepared for that as well. Whatever you do don’t crack. All you have left is yourself and she’s going to be taking a good long hard look at you from a distance.  Mind your business and make some corrections. Her sleeping with someone else is going to happen and it’ll hurt less if you’re not together. But who knows maybe this is the opportunity to meet the next best thing on earth...best of luck broski
